episode.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define (find-bar color)
               (let* ((cells (find-color g color)))
                 (if (null? cells)
                     #f
                     (let* ((r1 (min-of first cells))
                            (r2 (max-of first cells))
                            (cl (min-of second cells))
                            (cr (max-of second cells)))
                       (list r1 (+ 1 (- r2 r1)) cl cr)))))
             (define (bar-reaches? bar r c)
               (and
                 bar
                 (let* ((r1 (first bar))
                        (bh (second bar))
                        (cl (third bar))
                        (cr (fourth bar))
                        (dr (- r r1))
                        (k (if (>= dr 0)
                               (quotient dr (* bh 2))
                               (quotient (+ (- 0 dr) (- (* bh 2) 1)) (* bh 2)))))
                   (or (= c (- cl k)) (= c (+ cr k))))))
             (let* ((gb (find-bar 3))
                    (cb (find-bar 8)))
               (cellmap g
                        (r c v)
                        (let* ((has-g (bar-reaches? gb r c))
                               (has-c (bar-reaches? cb r c)))
                          (cond ((and has-g has-c) 6) (has-g 3) (has-c 8) (else 0)))))))))
